primaryIssue.description: Build validator completely ignores scope parameters
evidence: Tested 4 different scope patterns: default, custom (*.json,tsconfig.json), multi-pattern (src/**/*.ts,*.json), empty (nonexistent/**/*.nothing)
All scope patterns produced identical results and execution times (~60 seconds)
Validator executes same 4 tests regardless of scope: Clean Build, TypeScript Type Checking, Dependency Validation, Build Artifact Verification
Code analysis shows this.scopes = [] (empty array) in build-validator.js line 30
validate() method does not use scopeConfig parameter passed to it
primaryIssue.impact: Users cannot limit build validation to specific file patterns or directories, making validation inefficient for large projects or targeted changes

cleanBuildTest.evidence: Build stdout captured showing 'templum@1.0.0 build > tsc' with actual TypeScript errors

typeScriptTypeChecking.evidence: Found legitimate TypeScript error: Cannot find module './agents' or its corresponding type declarations

dependencyValidation.evidence: Dependency tree analysis completed, passed validation

buildArtifactVerification.evidence: Checked for dist/build/out directories, found dist directory but no build files

performanceAnalysis.timeoutCompliance: All tests completed within configured timeouts

issueAnalysis.rootCause: Build validator design treats build validation as inherently project-wide operation
designFlaws: Empty scopes array (this.scopes = []) indicates no scope support intended
validate() method signature accepts scopeConfig but never uses it
All test methods (executeCleanBuildTest, executeTypeScriptTypeChecking, etc.) operate on entire project

uiValidator.scopeRespected: likely_yes (much shorter execution suggests targeted analysis)

recommendedFixes.description: Modify build validator to respect scope parameters
recommendedFixes.approach: Add file pattern matching before executing build commands, or skip tests when scope doesn't match build-relevant patterns
